Adaptation costs are incurred when property is put in service for a different use than originally intended, such as converting a machine for use in manufacturing when it had originally been acquired for research and development activities of the company.

("Costs incurred to fix defective machinery that existed prior to acqui…" / "Costs incurred to convert existing manufacturing equipment to robotic…") Costs incurred to fix defective machinery that existed prior to acquisition and to convert existing manufacturing equipment to robotic manufacturing equipment are examples of betterment costs.

("Cost incurred to reconstruct a warehouse's support beams to comply wi…") Cost incurred to reconstruct a warehouse's support beams to comply with new building codes is an example of a restoration cost.
questions.explanationJa: 有形資産の修繕・維持費は発生時に費用処理するが、改良（betterment）、用途変更（adaptation）、回復（restoration）に当たる支出は資本化しなければならない。用途変更とは、資産を当初予定していた用途とは別の用途に供することをいい、研究開発用に使っていた設備を製造用に改造する費用がこれに当たる。取得前から存在した機械の欠陥の修理や、既存設備のロボット化は改良に当たる。新しい建築基準に適合させるための支持梁の再建は回復に当たる。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Property Tax Transactions Q.55

questions.stem: On May 1, Year 4, a taxpayer inherited undeveloped land with a fair market value at the date of the decedent's death of $800,000. The decedent had paid $700,000 for the property in Year 2. Estate taxes attributed to the property were $5,000. The taxpayer sold the undeveloped land on July 1, Year 4, for $820,000. What is the nature and amount of the taxpayer's reported gain on the sale in Year 4?
questions.explanation:
In this scenario, the beneficiary's basis is $800,000, the FMV of the property at date of death. The holding period is considered long-term even though the taxpayer owned it for only two months. The sale for $820,000 results in a long-term capital gain of $20,000 ($820,000 − $800,000).

Note:
A taxpayer's basis for inherited property is generally the FMV on the date of death, not the historic cost of the property. The holding period for inherited property is always considered long-term. Any estate tax paid related to the inheritance is not added to the beneficiary's basis of property received.
questions.explanationJa: 相続財産の基礎価額は、被相続人の取得原価ではなく死亡日時点の公正価値$800,000である。相続財産に係る遺産税は基礎価額に加算しない。また相続財産の保有期間は常に長期として扱うため、実際の保有期間が2か月でも長期となる。したがって$820,000 − $800,000 = $20,000の長期キャピタルゲインである。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Property Tax Transactions Q.56

questions.stem: An individual taxpayer sold a painting held for personal use for $50,000. The individual purchased the painting two years ago for $20,000. How should the sale be reported on the individual's income tax return?

choices.label: D
choices.text: Ordinary income of $30,000 and Section 1231 gain of $20,000.

questions.explanation:
Capital asset is property owned by a taxpayer that is not:

Used in a trade or business

Self-created intangible property (copyrights)

Personal use property is a capital asset because it is not used for any of the previously listed purposes. Gains on capital assets owned by the taxpayer for longer than one year are treated as long-term capital gains. Therefore, the personal use painting in this scenario is a long-term capital asset sold at a $30,000 gain ($50,000 sale price − $20,000 cost). Accordingly, the individual taxpayer should report a long-term capital gain of $30,000 for the sale of the personal use painting.

Note: Losses on personal use assets are nondeductible.
questions.explanationJa: 私用資産は、事業用資産や自己創作の無形資産などに当たらないため資本資産である。1年超保有した資本資産の売却益は長期キャピタルゲインとなる。絵画は2年前に$20,000で購入し$50,000で売却しているため、$30,000の長期キャピタルゲインを報告する。なお、私用資産の売却損は控除できない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Property Tax Transactions Q.57

questions.stem:
A self-employed individual purchased a piece of equipment for use in the individual's business. The costs associated with the acquisition of the equipment were:

Purchase price | $55,000
Delivery charges | $725
Installation fees | $300
Sales tax | $3,400

What is the depreciable basis of the equipment?
questions.explanation:
In this scenario, all the costs incurred are connected to the taxpayer acquiring (purchase price, delivery charges, sales tax) and placing the equipment into service (installation fees). Therefore, the depreciable basis of the equipment is $59,425.

Purchase price | $55,000
Delivery charges | 725
Installation fees | 300
Sales tax | 3,400
Depreciable basis | $59,425
questions.explanationJa: 償却基礎価額には、資産の取得と事業の用に供するまでに要したすべての支出を含める。購入価格、配送料、売上税は取得のための支出、据付費用は供用のための支出である。したがって基礎価額は$55,000 + $725 + $300 + $3,400 = $59,425となる。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Property Tax Transactions Q.58

questions.stem: In June, Year 3, two unrelated taxpayers purchased a home costing $380,000 as joint owners, each owning a 50 percent interest. It is the first home purchased by either taxpayer. The taxpayers used the home as their principal residence. In August, Year 6, the house was sold for $870,000 and $20,000 in commissions were paid. What amount of gain is reportable on each taxpayer's return in Year 6?
questions.explanation:
In this scenario, both taxpayers met the requirements for the exclusion. Each taxpayer is allocated 50% of the realized gain that is offset by the individual $250,000 exclusion. Because each taxpayer's $235,000 realized gain is less than the $250,000 exclusion, $0 is recognized and reported.

Total | Each taxpayer
Sales price | $870,000
Commissions paid | (20,000)
Net sales proceeds | $850,000
Adjusted basis of old home | (380,000)
Realized gain | $470,000
50% allocation ($470,000 / 2) |  | $235,000
Less exclusion (up to $250,000) |  | (235,000)
Recognized taxable gain |  | $0
questions.explanationJa: 純売却額は売却価額$870,000から仲介手数料$20,000を引いた$850,000で、取得価額$380,000を引いた実現利益は$470,000である。2人は50%ずつ所有しているため、各自の実現利益は$470,000 ÷ 2 = $235,000となる。両者とも主たる住居の除外要件を満たしており、各自の$250,000の除外枠で$235,000全額が除外されるため、各自が報告する利益は$0である。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Property Tax Transactions Q.59

questions.stem: In the current year, Vinton exchanged unimproved land for an apartment building. The land had a basis of $300,000 and a fair market value (FMV) of $420,000, and was encumbered by a $100,000 mortgage. The apartment building had an FMV of $550,000 and was encumbered by a $230,000 mortgage. Each party assumed the other's mortgage. What is Vinton's basis in the apartment building?
questions.explanation:
Vinton gave more boot than it received (debt assumed > debt released), no gain is recognized.

Basis of new property = FV of the property received - deferred gain

$430,000 = $550,000 - $120,000 ($420,000 - $300,000)

Or

Apartment building's basis: = / Land's adjusted basis + Mortgage increase − Mortgage decrease + Recognized gain
=: $300,000 + $230,000 - $100,000 + $0
=: $430,000
questions.explanationJa: Vintonは自らの土地の債務$100,000を免除される一方、アパートの債務$230,000を引き受けており、支払ったボートが受け取ったボートを上回るため、利益は認識されない。新資産の基礎価額は、旧資産の基礎価額$300,000 + 引き受けた債務$230,000 − 免除された債務$100,000 + 認識利益$0 = $430,000である。アパートの公正価値$550,000から繰延利益$120,000（$420,000 − $300,000）を引いても同額になる。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Property Tax Transactions Q.60

questions.stem:
An individual taxpayer reported the following net long-term capital gains and losses:

Year | Gain (loss)
1 | ($5,000)
2 | 1,000
3 | 4,000

The amount of capital gain that the individual taxpayer should report in Year 3 is
questions.explanation: In this scenario, the $5,000 net loss in Year 1 is limited to a $3,000 deduction. The unused $2,000 loss is carried forward to Year 2 and is netted against the $1,000 gain. The resulting $1,000 net loss is under the $3,000 limit and is fully deducted using up the loss carryforward. In Year 3, the $4,000 gain is unadjusted by any carryover and is reported in full.
questions.explanationJa: Year 1の純損失$5,000は$3,000までしか控除できず、残り$2,000をYear 2に繰り越す。Year 2では繰越損失$2,000と利益$1,000を相殺して$1,000の純損失となり、$3,000の限度内なので全額控除され、繰越損失は使い切られる。したがってYear 3には繰越額がなく、$4,000の利益をそのまま報告する。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Property Tax Transactions Q.61

questions.stem: A taxpayer's property with an adjusted basis of $75,000 and fair market value of $105,000 was condemned by the state. The taxpayer received $100,000 from the state as compensation for the property, and six months after the condemnation purchased a replacement property for $100,000. What are the tax consequences of this transaction?

choices.label: A
choices.text: No gain is recognized, and the basis in the new property is $75,000.

choices.label: B
choices.text: No gain is recognized, and the basis in the new property is $100,000.

choices.label: C
choices.text: A gain of $25,000 is recognized, and the basis in the new property is $100,000.

choices.label: D
choices.text: A gain of $30,000 is recognized, and the basis in the new property is $100,000.

questions.explanation:
In this scenario, the taxpayer acquired replacement property within the statutory three-year period and reinvested all the proceeds. Therefore, the realized gain of $25,000 ($100,000 amount realized − $75,000 adjusted basis) is deferred. No gain is recognized. The basis in the replacement property is $75,000 ($100,000 cost − $25,000 deferred gain).

The basis of the replacement property is its cost less any deferred gain.
questions.explanationJa: 収用による非自発的転換では、法定の期間内に代替資産を取得し補償金を全額再投資すれば、実現利益を繰り延べられる。実現利益は補償金$100,000から調整後基礎価額$75,000を引いた$25,000であり、6か月後に$100,000で代替資産を購入したため利益は認識されない。代替資産の基礎価額は取得価額から繰延利益を引いた$100,000 − $25,000 = $75,000である。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Property Tax Transactions Q.62

questions.stem: In Year 3, a taxpayer's parent sold 100 shares of Gym Co. stock to the taxpayer for $11,000. The parent paid $15,000 for the stock in Year 1. Subsequently in Year 3, the taxpayer sold the stock to an unrelated third party for $16,000. What amount of gain should the taxpayer report on the Year 3 income tax return?
questions.explanation: The parent's $4,000 loss ($11,000 sale − $15,000 basis) on the stock sale to the taxpayer was disallowed because the parent and taxpayer are related parties. However, the loss can be deducted from the $5,000 gain ($16,000 sale − $11,000 basis) realized by the taxpayer upon selling the stock to the unrelated party. Therefore, the taxpayer's gain on the sale to the unrelated party is $1,000 ($5,000 realized gain - $4,000 parent's disallowed loss).
questions.explanationJa: 親から子への売却は関連当事者間の取引であるため、親の損失$4,000（$11,000 − $15,000）は否認される。ただし、取得した子がその後非関連者に売却して利益が出た場合、否認された損失をその利益から差し引ける。子の実現利益は$16,000 − $11,000 = $5,000で、親の否認損失$4,000を差し引いた$1,000が報告すべき利益となる。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Property Tax Transactions Q.63

questions.stem:
Individual Smith's Year 2 brokerage account statement listed the following capital gains and losses from the sale of stock investments:

Short-term capital gain | $ 5,000
Long-term capital gain | 10,000
Short-term capital loss | (7,000)

In Year 2, Smith sold the following Section 1231 assets related to his business. In July, Smith sold Section 1231 property, acquired in January of Year 1, for a gain of $4,000. In August, Smith sold Section 1231 property, acquired in March of Year 1, for a loss of $3,000.

What is Smith's net capital gain?
questions.explanation:
When a taxpayer disposes of a capital asset (stocks), the gain or loss is classified as long-term (LT) or short-term (ST) depending on the holding period. These gains and losses are netted and result in an overall net capital gain or loss.

Section 1231 assets (land, building, equipment) are used in a trade or business and held longer than one year. The sale of such property results in Section 1231 gains and losses, which are always LT. These gains and losses are initially netted. To allow the most favorable treatment of either a gain or loss:

A net Section 1231 gain is treated as an LT capital gain and included in the capital gain netting process, and

A net Section 1231 loss is treated as an ordinary loss, which may offset ordinary income.

In this scenario, the Section 1231 transactions result in a net gain of $1,000 ($4,000 − $3,000), which is treated as an LT capital gain. The taxpayer includes the $1,000 when netting the other capital transactions as follows:

LT capital gains ($1,000 + $10,000) |  | $11,000
ST capital gain | $5,000
Less ST capital loss | (7,000) | (2,000)
Net LT capital gain |  | $9,000

Therefore, the taxpayer has a net LT capital gain of $9,000.
questions.explanationJa: 1年超保有した事業用資産の売却損益はSection 1231損益として相殺し、純利益は長期キャピタルゲイン、純損失は通常損失として扱う。本問のSection 1231損益は$4,000 − $3,000 = $1,000の純利益であり、長期キャピタルゲインに加える。長期は$10,000 + $1,000 = $11,000、短期は$5,000 − $7,000 = $2,000の純損失となる。両者を相殺すると純長期キャピタルゲインは$11,000 − $2,000 = $9,000である。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Property Tax Transactions Q.64

questions.stem: Dove Corp. began operating a hardware store in the current year after constructing a building at a total cost of $100,000 on land previously acquired for $50,000. In the current year, the land had a fair market value of $60,000. Dove paid real estate taxes of $5,000 in the current year. What is the total depreciable basis of Dove's business property?
questions.explanation:
The cost of depreciable real property (buildings) includes all ordinary and necessary acquisition or construction costs and costs incurred to make the property ready for its intended use. The property's depreciable basis is the cost used to calculate depreciation for tax purposes. Operating expenses (taxes, repairs) associated with the property are expensed, not capitalized.

In this scenario, the hardware store (building), which cost $100,000 to construct, is Dove Corp.'s only depreciable property since the land is not depreciable. Therefore, the total depreciable basis of Dove's property is $100,000.
questions.explanationJa: 不動産の償却基礎価額には、取得・建設に要した支出と使用可能な状態にするための支出を含める。土地は減価償却できず、固定資産税などの運営費は資本化せず費用処理する。したがって償却対象は建設費$100,000の建物のみであり、償却基礎価額は$100,000である。土地の取得価額$50,000や公正価値$60,000は関係しない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG Property Tax Transactions Q.65

questions.stem: A taxpayer purchased five acres of land for $20,000 and placed in service other tangible business assets that cost $100,000. Disregarding business income limitations and assuming that the annual Section 179 (Election to Expense Certain Depreciable Business Assets) limit is $108,000, what maximum amount of cost recovery can the taxpayer claim this year?
questions.explanation:
Land is not depreciable and is not Section 179 property, so the $20,000 cost of the land produces no cost recovery deduction. The Section 179 deduction is limited to the cost of qualifying property placed in service (IRC §179(b)). The other tangible business assets cost $100,000, which is below the assumed $108,000 annual limit, so the taxpayer can expense the entire $100,000.

Maximum cost recovery = $100,000 (tangible business assets) + $0 (land) = $100,000

The $120,000 amount incorrectly includes the cost of the land.
The $108,000 amount is the annual dollar limit, but the deduction cannot exceed the $100,000 cost of qualifying property.
The $20,000 amount is the cost of the land, which is not recoverable through depreciation.
questions.explanationJa:
土地は減価償却資産ではなく、Section 179 の対象資産でもないので、土地の取得価額 $20,000 から費用化できる額はない。Section 179 の控除額は対象資産の取得価額が上限で、事業用有形資産の取得価額 $100,000 は年間限度額 $108,000 を下回るため、$100,000 全額を費用化できる。
$120,000 は土地を含めている。$108,000 は限度額であり、取得価額 $100,000 を超えて控除することはできない。$20,000 は土地の取得価額で、費用化できない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG 2011 Recently Released Q.10 (AICPA No. 9850)

questions.stem: In the current year, Essex sold land with a basis of $80,000 to Yarrow for $100,000. Yarrow paid $25,000 down and agreed to pay $15,000 per year, plus interest, for the next five years, beginning in the second year. Under the installment method, what gain should Essex include in gross income for the year of sale?
questions.explanation:
Under the installment method (IRC §453), the gain recognized in a year equals the payments received in that year multiplied by the gross profit percentage.

Gross profit = $100,000 - $80,000 = $20,000
Gross profit percentage = $20,000 / $100,000 = 20%
Payment received in year of sale = $25,000
Gain recognized in year of sale = $25,000 x 20% = $5,000

The $25,000 amount is the down payment, not the gain portion of the payment.
The $20,000 amount is the total gain on the sale, which is spread over the payments received.
The $15,000 amount is the amount of each later annual installment.
questions.explanationJa:
割賦基準（IRC §453）では、各年に認識する利益 = その年の受取額 × 売上総利益率。
売上総利益 = $100,000 − $80,000 = $20,000、利益率 = 20%、売却年の受取額 $25,000 × 20% = $5,000。
$25,000 は頭金そのもの。$20,000 は譲渡益の総額で、受取りに応じて配分される。$15,000 は翌年以降の年賦額。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG 2011 Recently Released Q.28 (AICPA No. 9968)

questions.stem: Decker sold equipment for $200,000. The equipment was purchased for $160,000 and had accumulated depreciation of $60,000. What amount is reported as ordinary income under Code Sec. 1245?
questions.explanation:
Gain on the sale of depreciable personal property is ordinary income under IRC §1245 to the extent of the lesser of the gain recognized or the depreciation previously deducted. Any remaining gain is Section 1231 gain.

Adjusted basis = $160,000 - $60,000 = $100,000
Gain = $200,000 - $100,000 = $100,000
Section 1245 ordinary income = lesser of $100,000 gain or $60,000 depreciation = $60,000
Section 1231 gain = $100,000 - $60,000 = $40,000

The $0 amount ignores depreciation recapture on equipment.
The $40,000 amount is the Section 1231 portion (appreciation above original cost), not the recapture.
The $100,000 amount treats the entire gain as ordinary income, although recapture cannot exceed the depreciation taken.
questions.explanationJa:
償却資産（動産）の売却益のうち、売却益と償却累計額のいずれか少ない額が §1245 により通常所得となり、残りは §1231 の利益となる。
簿価 = $160,000 − $60,000 = $100,000、売却益 = $200,000 − $100,000 = $100,000、§1245 通常所得 = min($100,000, $60,000) = $60,000、§1231 利益 = $40,000。
$0 は償却の取戻しを無視している。$40,000 は取得価額を超える値上がり分（§1231）。$100,000 は全額を通常所得としているが、取戻しは償却額が上限。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG 2011 Recently Released Q.31 (AICPA No. 9971)

questions.stem:
Gem Corp. purchased all the assets of a sole proprietorship, including the following intangible assets:

Goodwill | $50,000
Covenant not to compete | 13,000

For tax purposes, what amount of these purchased intangible assets should Gem amortize over the specific statutory cost recovery periods?
questions.explanation:
Under IRC §197, goodwill and a covenant not to compete entered into in connection with the acquisition of a trade or business are both Section 197 intangibles. Each is amortized ratably over the statutory 15-year period beginning with the month of acquisition, regardless of the covenant's actual term.

Amortizable Section 197 intangibles = $50,000 goodwill + $13,000 covenant = $63,000

The $50,000 amount omits the covenant not to compete, which is also a Section 197 intangible when acquired with a business.
The $13,000 amount omits goodwill, which is amortizable for tax purposes even though it is not amortized for financial reporting.
The $0 amount incorrectly treats these intangibles as nonamortizable.
questions.explanationJa:
事業の取得に伴って取得したのれんと競業避止契約は、いずれも §197 無形資産として、取得月から15年で定額償却する（競業避止契約の実際の期間にかかわらない）。
償却対象 = のれん $50,000 + 競業避止 $13,000 = $63,000。
$50,000 は競業避止契約を漏らしている。$13,000 はのれんを漏らしている（税務ではのれんも償却する）。$0 は両方とも償却しないとしており誤り。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG 2012 Recently Released Q.2 (AICPA No. 89802)

questions.stem: In year 1, a taxpayer sold real property for $200,000, receiving $100,000 at closing and $100,000 plus accrued interest at the prime rate in the next year. The buyer also assumed a $50,000 mortgage on the property. The taxpayer's adjusted basis was $75,000, and the taxpayer incurred $10,000 of selling expenses. If this transaction qualifies for installment sale treatment, what is the gross profit on the sale?
questions.explanation:
Under the installment method, gross profit equals the selling price less the adjusted basis and selling expenses (Treas. Reg. §15a.453-1(b)(2)). The selling price includes the cash payments and the mortgage assumed by the buyer.

Selling price = $100,000 + $100,000 + $50,000 mortgage assumed = $250,000
Gross profit = $250,000 - $75,000 adjusted basis - $10,000 selling expenses = $165,000

The $115,000 amount omits the $50,000 mortgage assumed by the buyer from the selling price.
The $125,000 amount omits the mortgage and the selling expenses from the computation.
The $175,000 amount fails to subtract the $10,000 of selling expenses.
questions.explanationJa:
割賦基準の売上総利益 = 売却価額 − 簿価 − 売却費用（Treas. Reg. §15a.453-1(b)(2)）。売却価額には現金の支払額に加えて買主が引き受けた抵当債務も含む。
売却価額 = $100,000 + $100,000 + 引受債務 $50,000 = $250,000、売上総利益 = $250,000 − $75,000 − $10,000 = $165,000。
$115,000 は引受債務を売却価額に含めていない。$125,000 は引受債務と売却費用の両方を考慮していない。$175,000 は売却費用を差し引いていない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG 2012 Recently Released Q.16 (AICPA No. 89816)

questions.stem: For an individual business owner, which of the following would typically be classified as a capital asset for federal income tax purposes?

choices.label: C
choices.text: Machinery and equipment used in a business

questions.explanation:
IRC §1221 defines a capital asset as all property held by the taxpayer except listed exclusions, including inventory and property held primarily for sale to customers, depreciable property and real property used in a trade or business, and accounts or notes receivable acquired in the ordinary course of business. Marketable securities held as investments are not excluded, so they are capital assets.

Accounts receivable acquired in the ordinary course of business for services or inventory sales are excluded by §1221(a)(4). Machinery and equipment used in a business is depreciable business property excluded by §1221(a)(2); it is Section 1231 property instead. Inventory is excluded by §1221(a)(1).
questions.explanationJa:
IRC §1221は、棚卸資産、事業で使用する減価償却資産・不動産、通常の営業過程で取得した売掛金・受取手形などを除き、納税者が保有するすべての財産を資本資産と定義する。投資として保有する市場性有価証券は除外項目に当たらないので資本資産である。

事業上の売掛金は§1221(a)(4)で除外。事業用の機械装置は§1221(a)(2)で除外され、Section 1231資産となる。棚卸資産は§1221(a)(1)で除外される。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG 2013 Recently Released Q.11 (AICPA No. 90211)

questions.stem: Simmons gives her child a gift of publicly-traded stock with a basis of $40,000 and a fair market value of $30,000. No gift tax is paid. The child subsequently sells the stock for $36,000. What is the child's recognized gain or loss, if any?
questions.explanation:
Under IRC §1015(a), when the fair market value of gifted property at the date of the gift is less than the donor's basis, the donee has a dual basis: the donor's basis is used to measure gain, and the lower fair market value is used to measure loss.

Gain basis = donor's basis = $40,000
Loss basis = FMV at gift = $30,000
Sale price = $36,000
Gain test: $36,000 - $40,000 = negative, so no gain
Loss test: $36,000 - $30,000 = positive, so no loss
The sale price falls between the two bases, so no gain or loss is recognized.

The $4,000 loss uses the donor's $40,000 basis to measure a loss, which is not allowed when FMV at the gift date is lower. The $6,000 gain uses the $30,000 FMV to measure a gain, but gain must be measured from the $40,000 donor basis. The $36,000 gain treats the stock as having zero basis.
questions.explanationJa:
IRC §1015(a)により、贈与時の時価が贈与者のベーシスを下回る場合、受贈者は二重ベーシスとなる。利得の計算には贈与者のベーシス、損失の計算には低い方の贈与時時価を使う。

利得用ベーシス = $40,000
損失用ベーシス = $30,000
売却価額 = $36,000
利得判定: $36,000 − $40,000 は負なので利得なし
損失判定: $36,000 − $30,000 は正なので損失なし
売却価額が両ベーシスの間にあるため、損益は認識されない。

$4,000の損失は贈与者のベーシス$40,000で損失を測っており誤り。$6,000の利得は時価$30,000で利得を測っており誤り。$36,000の利得はベーシスをゼロとしている。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG 2013 Recently Released Q.18 (AICPA No. 90218)

questions.stem: The sale of which of the following types of business property should be reported as Section 1231 (Property Used in the Trade or Business and Involuntary Conversions) property?
questions.explanation:
Section 1231 property is depreciable property and real property used in a trade or business and held for more than one year, excluding inventory and property held primarily for sale to customers (IRC §1231(b)(1)). Business land held for 18 months meets the more-than-one-year holding period, so its sale is reported as Section 1231 property.

Inventory held for resale is excluded from Section 1231 and produces ordinary income. Machinery held for only six months fails the more-than-one-year holding period, so its sale produces ordinary gain or loss. Cattle held for draft, breeding, dairy, or sporting purposes qualify only if held for 24 months or more (IRC §1231(b)(3)), so cattle held for 6 months do not qualify.
questions.explanationJa:
Section 1231資産は、事業で使用し1年超保有する減価償却資産と不動産で、棚卸資産や顧客への販売目的で保有するものを除く（§1231(b)(1)）。18か月保有した事業用土地は1年超の要件を満たす。

再販売目的の棚卸資産は1231から除外され通常所得となる。6か月しか保有していない機械は1年超の要件を満たさず通常損益となる。役畜・繁殖・酪農・競技用の牛は24か月以上の保有が必要（§1231(b)(3)）なので、6か月保有の牛は該当しない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG 2013 Recently Released Q.29 (AICPA No. 90229)

questions.stem: Which of the following types of costs are required to be capitalized under the Uniform Capitalization Rules of Code Sec. 263A?
questions.explanation:
The uniform capitalization (UNICAP) rules of IRC §263A require producers and resellers to capitalize direct costs and the indirect costs properly allocable to property produced or acquired for resale. Treas. Reg. §1.263A-1(e)(3) lists storage and warehousing costs among the indirect costs that must be capitalized to inventory.

Marketing, selling, and advertising costs are specifically excluded from capitalization. Distribution costs (outbound shipping to customers) are also excluded. General office maintenance relates to general administrative functions that do not directly benefit production or resale activities, so it is not required to be capitalized.
questions.explanationJa:
IRC §263Aの統一資本化（UNICAP）ルールにより、製造業者・再販業者は、製造又は再販目的で取得した資産に配賦すべき直接費と間接費を資本化しなければならない。Treas. Reg. §1.263A-1(e)(3)は、保管・倉庫費用を棚卸資産に資本化すべき間接費として挙げている。

マーケティング・販売・広告費は資本化の対象から明示的に除外される。顧客への配送費（販売物流費）も除外される。一般事務所の維持費は製造・再販活動に直接寄与しない一般管理機能の費用なので、資本化は求められない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG 2014 Recently Released Q.9 (AICPA No. 90559)

questions.stem: On March 1 of the previous year, a parent sold stock with a cost of $8,000 to their child, for $6,000, its fair market value. On September 30 of the current year, the child sold the same stock for $7,000 to Hancock, who is unrelated to the parent and child. What is the proper treatment for these transactions?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Parent has a $2,000 recognized loss and child has $1,000 recognized gain.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Parent has $2,000 recognized loss and child has $0 recognized gain.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Parent has $0 recognized loss and child has $1,000 recognized gain.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Parent has $0 recognized loss and child has $0 recognized gain.

questions.explanation:
Under IRC §267(a)(1), a loss on a sale between related parties is disallowed; a parent and child are related parties under IRC §267(b)(1) and §267(c)(4). Under IRC §267(d), when the related buyer later sells the property at a gain, the gain is recognized only to the extent it exceeds the loss previously disallowed to the seller.

Parent's realized loss = $6,000 - $8,000 = $2,000 loss, disallowed; recognized loss = $0
Child's basis = $6,000 purchase price
Child's realized gain = $7,000 - $6,000 = $1,000
Offset by parent's disallowed loss (up to the gain) = $1,000
Child's recognized gain = $0

A $2,000 recognized loss for the parent is not allowed because of §267(a)(1). A $1,000 recognized gain for the child ignores the §267(d) offset for the disallowed loss.
questions.explanationJa:
IRC §267(a)(1)により関連者間の売却損は否認される。親子は§267(b)(1)・§267(c)(4)の関連者に当たる。§267(d)により、購入した関連者が後に利得で売却した場合、利得は売主で否認された損失を超える部分だけが認識される。

親の実現損失 = $6,000 − $8,000 = $2,000の損失、否認され認識損失は$0
子のベーシス = 購入価額$6,000
子の実現利得 = $7,000 − $6,000 = $1,000
親の否認損失で相殺（利得の額まで）= $1,000
子の認識利得 = $0

親の$2,000の損失認識は§267(a)(1)により認められない。子の$1,000の利得認識は§267(d)による否認損失の相殺を無視している。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG 2014 Recently Released Q.12 (AICPA No. 90562)

questions.stem:
Prime Corporation's building was destroyed by a tornado. The fair market value of the building at the time of the tornado was $400,000 and its adjusted basis was $350,000. The insurance proceeds totaled $500,000 as follows:

$400,000 for the building
$100,000 for lost profits during rebuilding

Prime does not defer any gain under the involuntary conversion provisions of Code Sec. 1033. What amount of the insurance proceeds is taxable to Prime?
questions.explanation:
Insurance proceeds for a destroyed building are an amount realized on an involuntary conversion; the gain is the excess over adjusted basis. Because Prime does not elect to defer gain under IRC §1033, the gain is recognized. Insurance proceeds for lost profits replace income the business would otherwise have earned, so they are ordinary income under IRC §61 and are not eligible for §1033 deferral in any case.

Gain on building = $400,000 - $350,000 = $50,000
Lost profits proceeds = $100,000 (ordinary income)
Taxable proceeds = $50,000 + $100,000 = $150,000

The $0 amount ignores both the gain and the lost profits. The $50,000 amount includes only the gain on the building and omits the $100,000 for lost profits. The $100,000 amount includes only the lost profits and omits the $50,000 gain on the building.
questions.explanationJa:
焼失した建物の保険金は非自発的転換による譲渡対価であり、調整後ベーシスを超える額が利得となる。Primeは§1033による繰延べを選択しないので利得は認識される。逸失利益に対する保険金は本来得られた所得の代替であり、§61により通常所得となり、そもそも§1033の繰延べ対象ではない。

建物の利得 = $400,000 − $350,000 = $50,000
逸失利益の保険金 = $100,000（通常所得）
課税される保険金 = $50,000 + $100,000 = $150,000

$0は利得も逸失利益も無視している。$50,000は建物の利得のみで逸失利益$100,000を落としている。$100,000は逸失利益のみで建物の利得$50,000を落としている。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG 2014 Recently Released Q.29 (AICPA No. 90579)

questions.stem: IRC Section 263A requires the capitalization of certain indirect costs related to inventory when a qualifying business is manufacturing tangible personal property. Which of the following costs is not required to be capitalized as part of this adjustment?
questions.explanation:
Under the uniform capitalization (UNICAP) rules of IRC §263A, a producer of tangible personal property must capitalize direct costs and an allocable share of indirect costs, including service costs (such as personnel/recruiting, payroll, and security services) to the extent they benefit production. Treas. Reg. §1.263A-1(e)(3)(iii) specifically lists marketing, selling, and advertising costs as costs that are not required to be capitalized, so marketing is deducted currently.

Recruiting (personnel operations), payroll, and security services are service or indirect costs that must be allocated, in part, to produced inventory under Treas. Reg. §1.263A-1(e)(3) and (e)(4).
questions.explanationJa:
IRC §263AのUNICAP規定では、有形動産の製造者は直接費に加え、間接費のうち製造に寄与する部分（人事・採用、給与計算、警備などのサービス部門費を含む）を棚卸資産に資本化しなければならない。Treas. Reg. §1.263A-1(e)(3)(iii)は、マーケティング・販売・広告費を資本化不要の費用として明示しており、マーケティング費は当期の費用になる。

採用（人事業務）、給与計算、警備サービスは、Treas. Reg. §1.263A-1(e)(3)・(e)(4)により製造棚卸資産へ一部配賦すべき間接費・サービス費である。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG 2015 Recently Released Q.18 (AICPA No. 90818)

questions.stem: Kuo sells residential rental property to his son, Karl for $100,000. Karl gives Kuo $1,000 and an installment note for the balance of $99,000. Kuo's basis is $50,000. Karl pays Kuo $4,000 in year 1. In year 2, after paying Kuo $5,000, Karl sells the property for $70,000. Which of the following statements about this situation is correct?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Kuo should report the entire gain of $50,000 in year 1 because installment sales of depreciable property are not allowed between related parties.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Kuo should report $2,500 gain in year 1.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Kuo should report the entire gain of $50,000 in year 1 because Karl disposed of the land within two years of purchase.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Kuo should report a $49,000 gain in year 2.

questions.explanation:
Kuo may report the gain on the installment method. The gross profit percentage is the gross profit divided by the contract price.

Gross profit: $100,000 − $50,000 = $50,000
Gross profit percentage: $50,000 ÷ $100,000 = 50%
Payments received in year 1: $1,000 down payment + $4,000 = $5,000
Gain reported in year 1: $5,000 × 50% = $2,500

The related-party resale rule of IRC §453(e) applies when the related buyer resells within two years, but it accelerates gain only in the year of the resale (year 2). In year 2, the lesser of Karl's $70,000 amount realized or the $100,000 contract price is treated as received, reduced by the $10,000 of payments already received before the resale ($5,000 in year 1 and $5,000 in year 2), so $60,000 is deemed received in addition to the $5,000 actually received that year. Year 2 gain is ($5,000 + $60,000) × 50% = $32,500. Year 1 reporting is unaffected.

The statement about the entire $50,000 gain in year 1 because of depreciable property misapplies IRC §453(g); that rule covers related persons as defined in §1239(b) (a person and a controlled entity, etc.), not a parent and child. The statement about the entire $50,000 gain in year 1 because of a disposition within two years misstates §453(e), which accelerates gain in the year of the second disposition, not retroactively. A $49,000 gain in year 2 does not match the year 2 computation of $32,500.
questions.explanationJa:
Kuoは割賦基準で利得を報告できる。粗利益率は粗利益を契約価格で割って求める。

粗利益: $100,000 − $50,000 = $50,000
粗利益率: $50,000 ÷ $100,000 = 50%
1年目の受取額: 頭金$1,000 + $4,000 = $5,000
1年目の報告利得: $5,000 × 50% = $2,500

関連者が2年以内に転売した場合のIRC §453(e)は、転売した年（2年目）に利得を前倒し認識させるだけで、1年目の報告には影響しない。2年目は、Karlの譲渡対価$70,000と契約価格$100,000の小さい方（$70,000）から、転売前に受け取済みの$10,000（1年目$5,000と2年目$5,000）を引いた$60,000を追加で受け取ったものとみなし、2年目に実際に受け取る$5,000と合わせて、2年目の利得は($5,000 + $60,000) × 50% = $32,500となる。

減価償却資産を理由に1年目に$50,000全額とする記述は§453(g)の誤用である。同条の関連者は§1239(b)の定義（本人とその支配法人など）で、親子は含まれない。2年以内の処分を理由に1年目に全額とする記述は、§453(e)が転売年に前倒しする規定であることに反する。2年目に$49,000とする記述は、2年目の計算額$32,500と一致しない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG 2015 Recently Released Q.29 (AICPA No. 90829)

questions.stem: If a security becomes worthless in the current taxable year, it is treated as sold or exchanged on

choices.label: A
choices.text: The last day of the preceding taxable year

choices.label: B
choices.text: The last day of the current taxable year

choices.label: C
choices.text: The date it is deemed worthless

choices.label: D
choices.text: The first day of the current taxable year

questions.explanation:
Under IRC §165(g)(1), if a security that is a capital asset becomes worthless during the taxable year, the resulting loss is treated as a loss from the sale or exchange of a capital asset on the last day of that taxable year. This deemed date matters for the holding period: a security bought during the year can become a long-term loss if the last day of the year is more than one year after acquisition.

The rule does not use the last day of the preceding year, the first day of the current year, or the actual date the security became worthless.
questions.explanationJa:
IRC §165(g)(1)により、資本資産である有価証券が課税年度中に無価値となった場合、その損失はその課税年度の末日に資本資産を売却・交換したものとして扱われる。このみなし日は保有期間の判定に影響し、取得から年度末まで1年を超えれば長期損失になる。

前年度末日、当年度の初日、実際に無価値となった日はいずれも使わない。
